description: We are siblings curious to find out what we can do to explore the space.
summary:
Orbital Lab is an interactive space exploration game that challenges players to complete 100 increasingly difficult missions across different regions of space. Players pilot a spacecraft, avoid dangerous obstacles, collect resources, manage fuel, use shields, and complete mission-specific objectives.

The game features two distinct experiences: Serious Mode, which focuses on strategic spaceflight and resource management, and Chaos Mode, which introduces unpredictable events and fast-paced arcade gameplay. Each level presents a new challenge, encouraging players to improve their skills, adapt their strategies, and keep exploring.

Orbital Lab makes space exploration more engaging and accessible by turning mission-based challenges into an interactive gaming experience. It aims to inspire curiosity about space, encourage problem-solving, and make learning through exploration fun.
details:
How It Works

Orbital Lab is a browser-based space mission game where players control a spacecraft and complete a campaign of 100 levels. Each level introduces objectives and challenges that test the player's movement, timing, resource management, and decision-making.

Players can choose between two modes:

  • Serious Mode: Focuses on mission control, flight telemetry, fuel management, spacecraft damage, and strategic gameplay.
  • Chaos Mode: Offers faster-paced arcade gameplay, unpredictable events, bonus opportunities, and additional excitement.

The game includes spacecraft steering, boosting, energy shields, scanning pulses, fuel collection, repair kits, bonus caches, and obstacle avoidance. Players must complete the objectives of each level to unlock the next one. Failed missions can be retried, and progress is saved in the browser.

Benefits and Intended Impact

The project makes space exploration more approachable through interactive gameplay. It encourages strategic thinking, persistence, problem-solving, and curiosity about space missions. Its progressive difficulty helps players develop their skills while exploring increasingly challenging environments.

Technology Used

The project was developed as a web-based game using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It is designed to run in a web browser and supports keyboard and on-screen controls.

Creativity and Design

Orbital Lab combines a structured 100-level campaign with two contrasting gameplay styles. Its combination of mission objectives, resource collection, dynamic events, and retry mechanics creates an experience that balances learning, exploration, and entertainment.
